reason: The named independent lab and a report for each batch is exactly what I look for, and 200 mg elemental from bisglycinate with no oxide is a real dose. At $24.99 launch price it is close enough to Toplux that I would try one box, but not at $29.99.
objection: Brand new, so zero reviews to read, and $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli. I would want to open the lab report first and check it is a real lab and matches the label.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report turns out to be vague or not tied to a batch number, I walk. If there were a few real reviews and the full price came down near $25, I would consider a second box.
